name: Materiality Matrix Registry
description: Governed data asset defining AI decision materiality tiers per SR 26-02. This registry is the authoritative source for risk classification and must be used by all governance components.

tiers.name: Critical
tiers.description: High-stakes decisions requiring human-in-the-loop, DHITL voting, and full audit trail. Regulatory exposure, financial impact >$10M, legal liability, patient safety.

tiers.name: Elevated
tiers.description: Moderate risk decisions with automated audit logging but no mandatory human review. Operational impact, financial exposure $1M-$10M.

tiers.name: Benign
tiers.description: Low-risk informational queries with minimal audit requirements. General knowledge, factual queries, internal non-sensitive data.

audit_rules.immutability: Once a transaction is classified, the tier classification cannot be changed retroactively
audit_rules.logging: All tier decisions must be logged with timestamp, query hash, and classification reasoning
audit_rules.review_cycle: Registry review required quarterly, or upon material regulatory change
audit_rules.exception_process: Tier classification exceptions require CRO approval and documented justification
